subject.title: perf(ci): cut the pre-fan-out critical path and bin canonical main runs

question: Does the CI owner accept the source guards and PR checks as sufficient evidence for the changed canonical-main topology, or require explicit monitoring of the first canonical-main run after landing?
rationale: Only a canonical `push` exercises the moved debounce and compact-main branch; PR checks exercise the implementation but cannot directly observe that event path.

options.title: Require first-run monitoring
options.body: Rebase and merge only with an owner prepared to inspect the first canonical-main run for cancellation-before-fan-out, compact-bin planning, and aggregate-gate completion.

options.title: Accept static coverage
options.body: Accept the workflow guard and PR CI evidence as sufficient, with normal post-merge CI monitoring.

recommendation.title: Require first-run monitoring
recommendation.body: Rebase and merge only with an owner prepared to inspect the first canonical-main run for cancellation-before-fan-out, compact-bin planning, and aggregate-gate completion.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied context connects this person to the CI topology and release-validation workflow work.
